description: The format of a Clay micro's manifest: what the package can serve, require, request and contribute, inspectable without instantiating it. A breaking change to the format is a new NSID. The manifest is the `description` of the cartridge's micro contribution, filed under this id as its `schema`.

endpoints.description: A map from endpoint name to one member of the open union `methodEndpoint | callbackEndpoint | viewEndpoint`, each tagged by `$type`. A member with an unknown `$type` is carried verbatim and never served.

requires.description: What the micro needs another micro to serve (a method or a view). A requirement declares no access.

collection_requests.description: The collections the micro reads or writes. Every one declares an access.

entrypoints.description: The component exports a host drives, as fully qualified WIT interfaces. `installer` is reserved: it round-trips and is never executed.

request.description: One thing the package asks for. `contract` is the Lexicon reference of what is wanted (a method or view NSID, or the `nsid#def` token of a collection) and never a concrete supplier: configuration resolves `binding`, the package-local name, to one. Declaring a request grants no authority.

access.description: Open vocabulary: `read` or `write`. Absent on a requirement, required on a collection request.

tag.description: The NSID of the facet's datum.

collectionContract.description: A collection the package serves. `id` is the `nsid#def` token of the collection in the package's own Lexicon, and the schemas name sibling defs of the same file, or a requested one.

contribution.description: A row the package declares into a collection it requested with `write` access, by that request's binding.

value.description: The static row body, which the collection's own contract interprets.

linkDeclaration.description: The row value's link `index` refers to one of this package's own endpoints.

methodEndpoint.description: A request/response operation registered under `nsid` and routed by it to its one provider.

nsid.description: The NSID of the method's Lexicon.

callbackEndpoint.description: A request/response operation that is never registered: reachable only through a link or endpoint reference a row carries. Many micros may implement one contract.

implements.description: The NSID of the contract Lexicon.

viewEndpoint.description: A mountable presentation. Every view is a presentation component, so `implements` only names the contract another micro requires it by.

implements.description: The NSID of the contract Lexicon.
